name: Sarathi Udyog
description: Sarathi Udyog makes 100% vegetarian cashew biscuits, nankhatai, cakes, oil-free mango pickles, homemade red chilly powder and premium dry fruits in Udupi, Karnataka. Order on WhatsApp — delivery all over India.
whatsappMessage: Hi Sarathi Udyog, I would like to order {product}. Please share the price, availability and delivery charges to my pincode ______.

delivery.headline: Delivery available all over India
delivery.charges: Delivery charges depend on weight and pincode — we confirm the exact amount on WhatsApp before you pay.
delivery.time: Orders are packed fresh and usually dispatched within 1–2 working days.
delivery.localPickup: Local pickup available in Udupi district.
